title: Gothic Witch Storm
description: Three women stand on a broken stone courtyard in front of a towering pink and black gothic cathedral under a dark stormy sky with green aurora and lightning. A blonde woman wearing a black crown and ornate black gown holds a staff while a blue-skinned woman in a pink and black dress stands beside her; a third woman in a pink dress kneels before them surrounded by shattered white masks.
prompt: Three powerful women in a dramatic scene: a regal blonde witch queen with flowing green hair wearing a black crown and elaborate black gown with pink accents stands center, a blue-skinned fantasy woman in a revealing pink and black dress stands to her right, while another woman in a pink gothic dress kneels submissively at their feet. They are positioned on a cracked stone courtyard littered with broken white masks in front of a massive pink and black gothic cathedral under a turbulent purple sky with lightning and green aurora borealis.
